source_title: Entertainment Katrina Kaif Breaks Silence On Post-Pregnancy Trolling, Asks 'Bounce Back? From Where?'
source_excerpt:
Katrina Kaif has responded to the online scrutiny of her postpartum appearance, questioning why women are expected to quickly regain their pre-pregnancy bodies after childbirth. In an interview with Vogue India, the actor spoke about the pressure women face to meet society's expectations. She also said that she wants to focus on motherhood and the next chapter of her life.
The discussion follows Katrina Kaif’s appearance at a Ganesh Chaturthi pandal in Mumbai this year, marking one of her first major public outings in months. Pictures from the event soon drew online trolling, with social media users comparing her pre-pregnancy appearance with recent photographs.
ALSO READ: Samay Raina's 'Chilling With Girlfriend' Reply To Varun Dhawan's Call On 'Koffee With Karan' Sparks Dating Speculation
During the interview, Katrina challenged the phrase 'bounce back'. The phrase is commonly used to describe the expectation that women should return to their pre-pregnancy appearance shortly after childbirth.
She added, "I have taken a step ahead to something that was a deep desire in my heart, so why would I want to go back? The first few days after I gave birth, it was an indescribable feeling to see Vihaan’s face and know that four years of a tumultuous journey for me and Vicky had led to this. "
Katrina Kaif further said, " I am very aware of my fitness journey and where my body feels at its most energetic. I will reach there at my own pace.”
Addressing the online comments, Katrina said people cannot claim ignorance about the physical changes women experience after giving birth. She also made it clear that she would rather concentrate on her present life than allow public opinion to dictate how she feels about her body.
She said, “We live in a world that wants to blow us around in the ever-changing winds of opinions. I think most people are aware of what a woman’s body goes through after giving birth. And if they still choose to view that body through a harsh lens, it’s a personal choice. It can’t be blamed on a lack of information, because there is so much information out there. I just want to focus on this lovely part of my life and where I’m headed.”

Katrina Kaif faced online scrutiny after attending a Ganesh Chaturthi celebration in Mumbai with her husband, Vicky Kaushal. The outing marked one of her first major public appearances in months. Soon after, photographs from the event began circulating on social media, with users sharing before-and-after collages comparing her pre-pregnancy appearance with recent pictures. The comparisons sparked criticism from people who called out the body-shaming and unrealistic expectations placed on women to regain their pre-pregnancy appearance soon after childbirth.
She responded to online scrutiny and trolling following her appearance at a Ganesh Chaturthi pandal, where her recent photographs were compared to her pre-pregnancy look.
She challenged the phrase 'bounce back,' questioning why women are expected to quickly regain their pre-pregnancy bodies after childbirth. She sees motherhood as a step forward.
She stated she would reach her fitness goals at her own pace, prioritizing how her body feels most energetic rather than conforming to public opinion.
She wants to focus on motherhood and the next chapter of her life, describing it as a deep desire of her heart, rather than public opinion.
